tools.name: search
tools.description:
Find published off-plan UAE developments by project name or slug text, combined with exact structured filters. Returns shortlist facts and a pagination cursor. Follow more pages only when the user's task needs them; a page's result count is not a total.

Use `suggest_project_terms` for a partial fac

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search canonical residential sale registrations in one required market: Dubai or Abu Dhabi. Whole area, project and building names ignore ASCII letter case; provider IDs match exactly. Filters combine with AND; date bounds are inclusive. Returns newest-first pages of 25 rows by default, at most 100.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one development's detail using a known ID, slug or Projectory URL; no prior search or facet lookup is needed. Returns development-wide pricing, location, availability, enquiry action, payment plan, grouped unit types, evidence, media and a plain-text description marked as untrusted source mate

tools.name: list_project_facets
tools.description: Explore all exact values for `emirate`, `area`, `developer`, `propertyType`, `availability` and `sort`, plus boolean flags `newLaunch` and `comingSoon`. Skip this call when the needed slugs are known. Use `suggest_project_terms` for a single partial facet name instead of downloading all choices.

tools.name: suggest_project_terms
tools.description: Resolve partial emirate, area, developer or property-type text, such as "marina" or "sobha", into exact filter slugs for `search`. Does not search project names. Skip when the exact slug is known; use `list_project_facets` to enumerate all values.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
